name: Vincamine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Hungary, first in 1980 — for heart harm and blood problems

summary: Vincamine was removed from the market in Germany and Hungary starting in 1980 due to reports of heart damage and blood issues [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated the drug and gave it a low score for liver risk [M]. This same computer model also gave the drug a low score for heart risk [M].
